subject: Bagging via STL + block bootstrap (12.5) -- survives the roster freeze
description:
12.5: transform -> STL-decompose -> BLOCK-bootstrap the remainder ('contiguous sections selected at random and joined together, because the remainder may itself be autocorrelated') -> add back trend and seasonal -> invert -> fit each simulated series -> average.

'Bergmeir et al. (2016) show that, on average, bagging gives better forecasts than just applying ETS() directly.'

WHY IT MATTERS HERE: SCAN_LOG distinguishes it sharply from 2.B4. '13.4 averages across MODEL FAMILIES; 12.5 averages across RESAMPLED VERSIONS OF THE SAME SERIES. The second is available even when the roster is fixed at one family, so it is COMPATIBLE WITH THE OUT-OF-SCOPE DECISION on the model roster.'

So this is the one accuracy-improving addition that does not touch the locked roster.

Blocked on task 18: requires STL, which inherits 13.9's missing-value constraint. Slower -- 'a lot more computation is required'.

Modelling-side; no matrix rebuild.
